app.name: Underwriting Calculator
app.description: The tile takeoff from Underwriting_Calculator.xlsx, as an app. Eight GAF measurements each carry their own waste allowance, every labor, material and client line has its quantity, unit price and total, and the totals work out the cost, the price and the margin. Quantities that round up to whole boxes and rolls are typed rather than derived — the App Builder's formulas have no ROUNDUP — and each of those fields shows the working it came from. The Takeoff calculator on the Underwriter page and on every quote does that rounding for you and is the quicker tool for pricing; this app is for keeping a takeoff as a record.
